concepts.gloss_en: the clarification and rectification of the imaginative faculty (through the spread of prophecy)

members.note: same action in same passage (lm2:8) via same cause (התפשטות הנבואה); 'בחינת כח המדמה' = 'המדמה', the imaginative faculty. Same referent state.

notes: Both forms name the same process/state (the clarifying-and-rectifying of the medameh) in the same Torah and immediate context; head verb identical, object is the same faculty phrased more/less fully.
